title: A 17 Year Old Just Made ManyChat Free
description:
Comment-to-DM automation works because of an official Meta feature called private replies, and Meta does not charge for it. What you pay ManyChat for is hosting, a dashboard, and somebody maintaining it. ManyChat prices per contact, so a post that performs well raises your bill.

OpenReply is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted project that does the core keyword-to-DM job through the same official Meta API, with no scraping and no password sharing. Your only cost is hosting.

One honest caveat: it is a young project with around 1,700 stars from a single maintainer, and it holds a live access token for your account. The guide covers the safe path, the trust checklist, and the settings that actually make comment-to-DM convert.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gACepQwSs7ST3fWlNJWV6NlycPJwQpCScpLLeT5S0i8/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #InstagramGrowth #OpenSource
transcript: This 17-year-old just fixed ManyChat's biggest problem, and it's completely free. It's called Open Reply, and it does the one thing you're actually paying ManyChat for. Somebody comments your keyword on a post, they get your link in their DMs a second later. That's it. That's the feature. ManyChat starts at $17 a month and climbs as you grow because they charge you per contact. So, the better a post does, the more you owe them. This one is free code you run yourself, which means a viral post costs you nothing extra. It runs on Meta's own official system, too, so there's no password sharing and no browser robot pretending to be you. Comment reply, and I'll send you the setup guide.
